APPROVE

The extraction preserves behaviour: the shard, `--passWithNoTests` and uncommitted sites are emitted in the same order, the `continue` chain becomes an equivalent `if`/`else if`/`else`, and the bucket lists keep the same insertion order. `Js` and every extracted helper look under 15. One caveat: I couldn't build it here, so the types it now names (`JsInventory.Inventory`, `JsInventory.Package`, `JsInventory.Selection`) and the warnings-as-errors build still need a compile to confirm.
